debugData.name: Namaqualand boulder 02 (scatter rocks)
debugData.description: Poly Haven namaqualand_boulder_02 (CC0, polyhaven.com/a/namaqualand_boulder_02), decimated by devTools/toolkit/buildNatureRocks.ts for the scatter (p308 D5): a sandstone boulder, 2.48 × 0.87 × 1.23 m, at 1,500 triangles (namaqualandBoulder02/Boulder), its base centre at its origin; positions, normals and UVs, no material (its texture set namaqualandBoulder02 through rockScatterNamaqualandBoulder02). Lossless: a scatter draws its items without their nodes, where a quantized encode puts its scale.
